technical_and_design_decisions: Refactor `ModuleRegistry` in Spring Cloud Data Flow to support dynamic, runtime registration and unregistration of module artifact coordinates instead of relying on hardcoded bootstrap initialization.
Implement REST API endpoints (`/modules`) in the Data Flow server for uploading and registering custom modules by type (source, processor, sink, task) and URI/coordinates.
Extend the Spring Cloud Data Flow Shell with dedicated CLI commands (e.g., `module register`, `module unregister`, `module list`) that invoke the new REST API endpoints.
Re-architect Spring XD modules (JMS, Mail, Mongo, MQTT, Reactor-IP, Stdout) into standalone Spring Boot applications based on Spring Cloud Stream programming models and binder abstraction.
assumptions: Development work will be performed by a single software engineer familiar with Java, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud Data Flow, and Spring Cloud Stream.
Existing Spring XD source repositories and module codebases for JMS, Mail, Mongo, MQTT, Reactor-IP, and Stdout are accessible for reference during migration.
Build pipelines, Maven repositories, and CI environments for spring-cloud-dataflow, spring-cloud-stream-modules, and spring-cloud-stream are established and functional.
Module registration accepts URI/Maven coordinates pointing to module artifacts, making module binary artifacts downloadable and discoverable by Data Flow at runtime.

activities.activity_name: Dynamic Module Registry & REST API Implementation
activities.activity_description: Refactor ModuleRegistry to replace hardcoded bootstrap logic with dynamic repository storage. Create REST controller endpoints for registering, listing, and unregistering modules (U1, U2).

activities.activity_name: Data Flow Shell Commands for Module Management
activities.activity_description: Implement shell commands and options in the Data Flow Shell to interact with the new module registration REST endpoints (U1, U2).
Port JMS module from Spring XD to s-c-s-m repository, converting configuration and beans to Spring Cloud Stream model with unit/integration tests (U3).
Port Mail module from Spring XD to s-c-s-m repository, adapting inbound/outbound adapters to Spring Cloud Stream bindings with tests (U4).
Port MongoDB source/sink module from Spring XD to s-c-s-m repository, implementing Spring Boot auto-configuration and integration tests (U5).
Port MQTT module from Spring XD to s-c-s repository, converting MQTT channel adapters to Spring Cloud Stream components with integration tests (U6).
Port Reactor-IP (TCP/UDP) module from Spring XD to s-c-s repository using Project Reactor and Spring Integration IP adapters with tests (U7).
Port Stdout sink module from Spring XD to s-c-s repository, setting up logging sink bindings and unit tests (U8).
Verify custom module uploading via REST/Shell and execute end-to-end stream pipelines using the newly migrated modules in a local test deployment.
Document new Shell/REST APIs for module registration, update reference documentation, and prepare release notes.
